Project: careful cravings
Description: A door dash type site that uses ai to generate healthy meal ordering in real tiume via user preferences

Goals:
- Launch a functional MVP with AI-driven meal recommendations:
- Onboard 50+ local health-focused restaurant partners:
- Achieve seamless integration of real-time nutritional data:
- Maintain high user retention through personalized dietary profiles:

Phases:
- Discovery & Architecture: Defining technical requirements and AI model logic.
- Development & Integration: Building the core platform and integrating AI capabilities.
- Testing & Deployment: Quality assurance and market launch.

Objectives:
- Complete AI recommendation engine prototype by end of Phase 1.: Complete AI recommendation engine prototype by end of Phase 1.
- Integrate real-time GPS tracking for delivery drivers in Phase 2.: Integrate real-time GPS tracking for delivery drivers in Phase 2.
- Achieve < 2 second latency for AI meal generation requests.: Achieve < 2 second latency for AI meal generation requests.

Automations:
- Bug Alert: Post alert to #dev-alerts channel
- Deployment Sync: Trigger CI/CD pipeline for staging deployment
- Requirement Tracking: Create corresponding task in Jira backlog

- AI Hallucination: Implement a secondary verification layer using verified nutritional databases.
- Logistics Latency: Use WebSocket for real-time communication and scalable cloud infrastructure.

- Core Development: Development & Integration
- Beta Testing: Testing & Deployment
